advisory.summary: Persistent Gearbox Bearing thermal anomaly detected on WTG-07. Estimated financial loss: INR 0.00 with Priority Score 67.1.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Evidence-grounded candidate explanation: High-speed shaft bearing mechanical wear or lubrication degradation causing thermal rise.

recommended_actions.action_text: Inspect gearbox high-speed shaft bearing lubrication levels, filter differential pressure, and oil particulate debris.
